title: Unique Crispy Canadian Refried Beans Tacos
description: A peppery, crispy, comforting Canadian dish featuring refried beans, mortar-pestle-pound, no-onion-no-garlic-friendly, perfect for a snack or lunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a mortar, pound the cilantro, salt, and black pepper into a coarse paste.
In a large bowl, mix the refried beans with the cilantro paste and lime juice until well combined.
Arrange the taco shells on a baking sheet and fill each shell with the bean mixture.
Sprinkle the shredded cheese over the beans in each shell.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the cheese.
Bake the tacos in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the shells are crispy.
Remove the tacos from the oven and top each one with diced tomatoes.
Serve the tacos hot and enjoy.
